faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Sausalito?
faq.answer: Sausalito homeowners typically invest $12,000 to $35,000+ for window replacement projects. This beloved Marin waterfront community's dramatic hillside homes, houseboats, and converted artists' studios feature distinctive window configurations — many requiring large custom sizes to frame unobstructed views of the Bay and Golden Gate. Marine-grade specifications add to project cost. Single window installation starts at approximately $750.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Sausalito?
faq.answer: Yes. Sausalito requires a building permit for window replacements. The City's Design Review Board may also need to approve exterior changes, particularly for properties with Bay views or located within scenic corridors. Our team manages all permit and design review applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Sausalito?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Sausalito commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Sausalito?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Sausalito replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Sausalito?
faq.answer: Most Sausalito projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
